description: This file provides a PHP API for interacting with the CCSP Data Model, including functions for getting, setting, adding, and deleting configuration objects and parameters. It acts as a wrapper over lower-level extension APIs to facilitate management of device configuration data.

methods.name: DmGetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Retrieves multiple parameter values under a specified root object by delegating to the extension API.

methods.name: DmSetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Sets multiple parameter values under a specified root object by delegating to the extension API.

methods.name: DmGetInstanceIds
methods.description: Retrieves instance IDs for a specified object table via the extension API.

methods.name: DmAddObj
methods.description: Adds a new object instance under a specified object table.
